searchText: found another gap in EEST thanks to the scheduled devnet5 runner. https://github.com/omerfirmak/zevm/pull/37 a really similar error to the previous one on my part 😄 https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3032 Nice to hear! Also cool you created the test. :) <@774033563732541451> i mixed up threads, [this](https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1517623278397685940/1518645008440496290) should be here 🙂 It should go up yeah, but unfort the Ethrex+Prysm combo gets stuck in the devnet once in a while 😅 I guess some consequences of being in an unstable devnet. ONce in a while i've to sync from scratch if I see things stuck. Which should i prob do now :/ But yeah, the expectation this dataset is growing at the same pace as the devnet is progressing at some point we won't be able to run them all on github You could keep the last checked one and run them in batches until catched up right? So not always run everything yeah, or partition, or similar seems like something solvable 😅 All this is heavily parallelizable to run blocks i run them in parallel, but at some point it won't be enough. but yeah, it's indeed solvable. anyway, it found quite a few bugs in both nethermind and zisk (now fixed) At some point whenever `glamsterdam-devnet-6` is launched, this als will have some implications of a new test-zkevm@... release thus prob guest program adjustments. So maybe we'll have two R2 buckets for a while of glamsterdam-5 and 6 for a while and at some point nuke the 5 one, no? Since that history might not be useful for that long So maybe overengineering the CI doesn't make much sense -- lmk your thoughts <@912415191067676693> (i'm just thinking out loud) i agree <@912415191067676693> fixed the nodes in the devnet, there're like 200 more batches already and hopefully keeps growing. (just fyi)
